DESIGN DECISION: file-only, same reasoning as watchlist.json. These are
product announcements and documentation, not research. They are recorded so
the vault has a view of the commercial landscape without any of it competing
Every quantitative figure below is VENDOR-REPORTED: the vendor evaluating
its own product. None was independently replicated in anything retrieved.

records.title: Improve your prompts in the developer console
records.topic: Console feature that refines a prompt using chain-of-thought reasoning, example standardization and example enrichment, with structured multi-shot example management and an 'ideal output' column for evaluation.
records.vendor_claims: Increased accuracy by 30% on a multilabel classification test; brought word-count adherence to 100% on a summarization task. Single internal test cases with no published methodology.
records.note: The post title is not 'Prompt Improver' — that is the feature name. Cite the actual title.

records.title: Optimize prompts | Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
records.published: UNVERIFIED — no last-updated date exposed on the page
records.topic: Documentation covering three optimizer modes: zero-shot, few-shot, and data-driven.
records.vendor_claims: None found in the retrieved content — capability documentation only.
records.note: Path sits under the 'Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform' namespace, the rebranded successor to the older Vertex AI generative-AI docs tree. Older citations to a vertex-ai/generative-ai/...prompt-optimizer path are likely stale. Cannot be staleness-ranked because no publication date is exposed.

records.title: Amazon Bedrock introduces new advanced prompt optimization and migration tool
records.topic: Optimize a prompt against up to five models at once; multimodal inputs (PNG/JPG/PDF); three evaluation methods (Lambda-based metrics, LLM-as-a-Judge with custom rubrics, or natural-language steering criteria); JSONL prompt templates with ground truth.
records.vendor_claims: None — no performance or benchmark numbers given. Capability and availability only.
records.note: One search summary reported 2026-06-26; the page and the corresponding AWS what's-new entry both indicate May 2026. Minor date conflict flagged.

records.title: PromptWizard: The future of prompt optimization through feedback-driven self-evolving prompts
records.topic: Announcement of the open-source PromptWizard framework jointly optimizing instructions and in-context examples via iterative LLM-generated feedback.
records.vendor_claims: Outperformed eight baselines across 45+ tasks; 69 API calls versus 1,730-18,600 for competitors; 24k tokens versus up to 1,488k; effective with as few as five examples; Llama-70B as optimizer roughly matching GPT-4. Microsoft's own evaluation of its own method.
records.note: Linked as a related_citation on the ACTIVE PromptWizard record (arXiv:2405.18369), which is the citable artefact. This blog is the vendor announcement only.

records.title: Introducing AgentKit
records.product_name: AgentKit (Agent Builder, ChatKit, Connector Registry, Evals)
records.exclusion_reason: RETIREMENT SCHEDULED — verified against OpenAI's first-party deprecations page on 2026-09-22. Agent Builder: deprecation announced 2026-06-03, shutdown 2026-11-30 (replacement: Agents SDK or ChatGPT Workspace Agents). Evals: read-only from 2026-10-31, shutdown 2026-11-30 (replacement: migration guide to Promptfoo). Per the curation rule, NOT ingested as durable guidance. ChatKit is not part of the wind-down and remains available.
records.topic: Launch of Agent Builder (drag-and-drop multi-agent workflow canvas), ChatKit (embeddable chat UI), Connector Registry, and Evals tooling.
records.vendor_claims: Not captured — the page returns HTTP 403 to automated fetch. Title and details came from search results and OpenAI's developer docs, not the page body.
